$comment: INERT planning example. Not registered, not loaded, not wired into any code. A complete, plausible PluginManifest for a FUTURE Smart Links plugin, mirroring the marketplace contract (crates/server/src/plugins/manifest.rs). Field names stay English (the plugin contract is the marketplace surface); host PROJECTUS domain identifiers (titulo, notas, projeto, tarefa, revision, atualizado_em) are untouched.
title: Smart Links
short_description: Inline backlinks and live link previews across notes, projects and tasks.
long_description: Smart Links turns plain references into a live web of connections. Type [[ inside the markdown editor to autocomplete and link to any nota, projeto or tarefa; hover a link to see a preview card (titulo, cor, atualizado_em); and open a per-entity backlinks panel that lists everything pointing at the current item. Links resolve by stable id, so they survive title edits and folder (pasta) moves. A global-search provider surfaces orphaned and broken links so the knowledge graph stays clean.
author: PROJECTUS Labs
changelog:
